text:
Avery: Hey folks, quick Q — I'm mapping who owns what for first-week triage. Can someone confirm who to ping for: (1) model rollout flags, (2) infra access for Private deployments, (3) oncall for hosted API incidents?

Sam: Welcome @Avery! Quick mapping from memory: (1) Model rollouts = Eng Platform (they own flags and canaries). (2) Private infra access = Eng Infra + People Ops for approvals. (3) Hosted API oncall = Eng SRE (pager). Short: Eng Platform = rollouts, Eng Infra = provisioning/access, Eng SRE = prod runbooks.

Diego: can confirm — Eng Platform owns rollout configs and canary gates. Ping me for canary windows. Typical channels: `#eng-platform` for config questions, `platform-oncall` for emergencies.

Priya: For Private deployment access please file the access request form: https://redwood-internal/sops/access-request and cc infra. We need justification + SOC-2 checklist. If customer/prod-sensitive, mark as high-priority and include the service owner.

infra-bot: Reminder: access requests require manager approval and ticket number. Template: `templates/access-template.md`. Quick CLI helper: ``./scripts/request_access --env private --justification "onboarding: infra access"``

Sam: Also, escalation path shorthand: Pager -> Eng SRE oncall -> if not resolved in 30m escalate to Eng SRE Lead + Eng Platform oncall. I'll add this to the new-hire checklist. :thumbsup:

Avery: awesome, thanks! Any quick owners list I can paste into my notes?

Sam: Pasteable owners list (copy/paste):
```
- Eng Platform: sam@redwood.com (rollouts, canaries)
- Eng Infra: priya@redwood.com (provisioning, private deploy access)
- Eng SRE oncall: platform-sre@pagerduty.com (prod incidents)
- Customer Success: cs@redwood.com (customer escalations)
- Security: security@redwood.com (compliance questions)
```

Diego: Added a short table to the onboarding wiki: https://redwood-internal/wiki/onboarding/owners — will keep it updated with oncall rotations.

Avery: Added to my notes and the checklist. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
